title: Usd Improvements | Clo 2025.0 Features Deep Dive
description:
The new update in CLO 2025.0 allows you to easily manage and preview various layers of a USD file directly in CLO, and export in USDZ format. Check out other new features here: https://www.clo3d.com/en/clo/features
